segments.text: Ok so, this is the programmatic control page in the CopilotKit docs, for Vue with Google Antigravity, and I have implemented this page in my project.
So this is my project, umm, and this is the exact code from the doc.
So the page only gives a run agent button and a stop button, for an agent called sales. After clicking run, the run goes through, uh, but the button shows no output at all.
And here's the problem. The only backend code on the page is this underscore common file, and it's just showcase helpers.

So basically, model, workspace, slug and the aimock helpers are never defined or imported. There's no agent and no app, and nothing registers sales. So, umm, you have to guess the backend. I pointed it at the quickstart agent just to run it.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
